props.name: align
props.description: Alignment along the cross axis.

props.name: autocomplete
props.description: The autocomplete attribute for the search input.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show a clear button when a value is selected.

props.name: clearIcon
props.description: Icon used when the action button clears the selection.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Whether Escape dismisses the popup.

props.name: closeOnOutsideClick
props.description: Whether outside interaction, pointer or focus, dismisses the popup.

props.name: createItem
props.description:
Factory used for unmatched free-text creation.
Providing it also enables the editable search input.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial popup state.

props.name: defaultSearchValue
props.description: Initial search text.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial values when uncontrolled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the control is disabled.

props.name: emptyRender
props.description: Content or render function for the empty state.

props.name: filterMethod
props.description: Filtering strategy or predicate receiving the raw item. `false` disables filtering.

props.name: flip
props.description: Whether to flip placement when the preferred side lacks space.

props.name: getItemLabel
props.description:
Plain-text label of an item, used for filtering, typeahead, form-value matching, and plain-text
display such as the Combobox input and MultiSelect tag title; does not change rendered labels.
Defaults to the string `label`, otherwise `String(value)`.

props.name: gutter
props.description: Gap in pixels between anchor and popup.

props.name: id
props.description: The ID of the control element.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Optional editable inner input element ref. Not assigned in non-editable mode.

props.name: isItemDisabled
props.description: Additional disabled policy evaluated against the current selection.

props.name: itemProps
props.description: Additional row attributes.

props.name: itemRender
props.description: Renderer for each collection item.

props.name: items
props.description: Source items, optionally grouped. Item values must be unique within the collection.

props.name: leading
props.description: Icon shown before the input/value area.

props.name: listboxProps
props.description: Additional listbox attributes.

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the select is in a loading state.

props.name: loadingIcon
props.description: Icon shown during loading state.

props.name: maxCount
props.description: Maximum number of selected values (multiple/tags).

props.name: maxTagCount
props.description: Maximum visible tags before collapsing the remainder into a +N summary.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the control, used for form submission.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called when clear is triggered.

props.name: onClosePrevented
props.description: Called when a dismissal attempt is blocked.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when popup state changes.

props.name: onReset
props.description: Post-reset notification after an unprevented native form reset.

props.name: onScrollBottom
props.description: Called once when scrolling reaches the bottom.

props.name: onSearchValueChange
props.description: Called when search text changes.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled popup state.

props.name: openOnControlClick
props.description:
Whether ordinary control/input pointer clicks open the popup.
Defaults to `false` when editable (`search` or `createItem` enabled),
or `true` when non-editable.

props.name: overflowPadding
props.description: Viewport collision padding in pixels.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown when no value is selected.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred popup placement relative to the anchor.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the control is read-only.

props.name: removeIcon
props.description: Icon used by tag remove buttons.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the control is required.

props.name: scrollBottomThreshold
props.description: Bottom threshold in pixels.

props.name: search
props.description: Whether the collection can be filtered through the editable input.

props.name: searchMaxLength
props.description: Maximum committed search length.

props.name: searchValue
props.description: Controlled search text.

props.name: shift
props.description: Cross-axis offset in pixels from the resolved placement.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: slide
props.description: Whether the popup may slide along its main axis to remain visible.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: tagOverflowRender
props.description: Content or render function for tags hidden by `maxTagCount`.

props.name: tagRender
props.description: Renderer for each selected tag.

props.name: tokenSeparators
props.description:
Strings that commit completed input tokens through `createItem` or an exact source match.
Duplicate separators are ignored and overlapping separators prefer the longest match.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Icon used when the action button opens the dropdown.

props.name: translations
props.description: Localized message overrides for this multi-select instance.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled values.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment of the component.

props.name: virtualizer
props.description:
Renders only the visible rows, such as `createListVirtualizer()`. Rows include group labels
and separators. The listbox is the scroll container, and keyboard highlight scrolls through
the virtualizer.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary item description.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether this item cannot be selected.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading item icon.

props.name: label
props.description: Visual label.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique selection and form value.
